name: PDH/PDL break that holds 30 min
why: A break of yesterday's high/low that holds 30 minutes means the other side's stops are gone and new participants accept the price; trapped faders cover. Pre-registered 2026-10-19 (research/preregistered/2026-10-19_gaps_and_holds.md).

scan.when: !rollwin && open < ph && open > pl && ((ll(1,30) > ph) || (hh(1,30) < pl))
